w2:textbox.label: Create Frame-based Modal Popup inside Window

1. Click the createWindow() button.
2. Select the frameModal option for the openPopup() method within the window. (“frame”, ‘parent’, “top”, WindowContainer ID)
3. Click the $p.openPopup() button within the window.
4. Verify the popup's operational scope based on the selected option.
    “frame”: Operates only within the specified frame.
    “parent”: Operates only within the parent frame.
    “top”: Operates on the entire browser window.
    WindowContainer ID: Operates only within the WindowContainer. (In the example, the WindowContainer ID is obtained via $p.getFrame().getParentFrame().getParentFrame().id.)
